messages:
Jana: Quick sync — we keep getting support tickets where the SDK shows a generic "limit exceeded" message and the console shows a different copy. Users can't tell if it's per-key throttle, org-level quota, or a temporary burst cap. I want a single canonical response shape + clear SDK/console copy. Thoughts?

Max: Yes — we've been inconsistent. My vote: structured error with `scope` and `reason` fields + `retry_after`. Minimal surface for SDKs but full details in console.

Tara: Agreed. From product perspective we should avoid exposing raw numeric limits in messages (can fuel support questions). Instead show human-friendly text + link to quota page. e.g. "Your organization has reached its request quota. Visit the Quotas page to upgrade or wait X minutes."

Kofi: one nuance: burst controls differ from sustained quotas. If we only say "quota exceeded" people won't know whether to backoff for 1s or hours. Can we include `quota_type`: "burst" | "sustained"? That keeps message short but precise.

James: here's a suggestion for canonical payload (SDKs parse this, console uses same fields to render richer UI):

```
{
  "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
  "scope": "org",          // "org" | "key" | "project"
  "quota_type": "burst",  // "burst" | "sustained"
  "retry_after": 8,        // seconds; optional
  "hint": "try_reducing_concurrency_or_upgrade",
  "support_link": "https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/123/quotas"
}
```

James: SDK copies can be like: "Request limit reached for your organization. Retry in ~8s or visit the Quotas page to increase capacity: <link>". Console can expand: show timeframe, current usage graph, and a CTA to request bump.

Max: slight security concern: don't include org id or exact limit in API errors returned to client. The payload above is fine as long as the support_link is generic/opaque (tokenized).

Tara: +1. Also want a fallback for old SDKs that don't parse fields: fallback to a single message string in the response body named `message` so older clients display something meaningful.

Jana: good catch. So canonical response will include both structured fields and a `message` string. Example final payload we can propose to eng-runtime: 

```
{
  "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
  "message": "Organization request quota exceeded. Retry in 8s or visit the Quotas page to upgrade.",
  "scope": "org",
  "quota_type": "burst",
  "retry_after": 8,
  "support_link": "https://console.redwood.ai/quotas?ref=api-error"
}
```

Kofi: UX note — console should correlate the error to the exact org/project and offer a 1-click diagnostics view (recent spikes, top endpoints). That reduces support load.

James: docs-bot: can we add a short snippet to SDK docs showing how to detect throttles and implement exponential backoff using `retry_after` when present? Also specify that `scope` can be used to change escalation (contact account team for org limits).

docs-bot: noted. I'll draft a docs PR with code samples for JS/Python and a short migration note for older SDKs. ETA: EOD Thursday.

Tara: copy for console modal — two lines + CTA: 
- "Your organization has reached its request capacity (burst)."
- "Automatic retry available in ~8s. Upgrade for sustained higher throughput."
CTA: "Open Quotas" (links to support_link). Keep the modal terse.

Max: engineering to implement structured error by next sprint? Runtime needs to map internal limiter -> these fields and ensure consistent headers too (X-RateLimit-Policy: org=burst). I can own runtime changes.

Jana: action items:
- James/docs-bot: PR for SDK docs + migration samples (ETA Thu EOD)
- Max: runtime mapping and header parity (start of next sprint)
- Kofi/Tara: console modal + diagnostics flow copy + mockups (mockups by Tue)
- Support: prepare canned reply using new copy (I'll draft)

Jana: thanks all — if no objections I'll file a single RFC and link the docs PR and runtime ticket. We should aim for a coordinated roll-out to avoid mixed messaging. :thumbsup:

Max: :+1:

Kofi: sounds good.

Tara: I can help coordinate communication to CS.

James: will draft the example payloads and SDK text after lunch and link here.

Jana: perfect — I'll create the RFC and ping infra for rollout windows.
